label: Hiking & biking trails
description: Count of OpenStreetMap ways tagged with sac_scale (the hiking-difficulty tag applied to real trails, not urban sidewalks) whose highway type is path/footway/track/cycleway/bridleway, plus hiking/mountain-biking route relations, within 20km of the town center. Queried live from the Overpass API (Overpass QL: [out:json][timeout:50];(way["highway"~"^(path|footway|track|cycleway|bridleway)$"]["sac_scale"](around:20000,lat,lng);relation["route"~"^(hiking|mtb)$"](around:20000,lat,lng););out count;) on 2026-11-07, via https://maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass/api/interpreter (raw per-town responses cached under data/raw/trails/<town-id>.json). draper re-queried separately on 2026-11-07, via https://maps.mail.ru/osm/tools/overpass/api/interpreter (raw per-town responses cached under data/raw/trails/<town-id>.json).
source: OpenStreetMap contributors, via the Overpass API
